name: More shopping
about: The next 300 Dutch words for shopping and money, by how much they're used, each in an everyday sentence written for it. They're the same sentences as in the Dutch word packs (words 1–20,000), so what you learn here counts there too, and the other way round. Word list: FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, from OpenSubtitles (opensubtitles.org), CC BY-SA 4.0.
